newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FARMERS MAIN BENEFICIARIES OF 97 BUDGET - MIN.
newsitem.headline: GREEK FARMERS MAIN BENEFICIARIES OF 97 BUDGET - MIN.

text.p: Greece's farmers have received the best deal of all in the ruling socialists' 1997 budget, Deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis said in Thursday's financial weekly Ekonomikos Tahydromos.
"I can say that the farmers are the most favoured in our budget," Christodoulakis, a former economic adviser to Prime Minister Costas Simitis, said.
Finance ministry figures showed that farmers paid less than any other group in income taxes in 1995.

Greek farmers have blockaded the country's highways for eight few days protesting against government policies seeking "Farmers' pensions this year will be up by 44 billion drachmas. OGA (the farmers' pension fund) subsidies will be increased, and the state will support the co-financing of a main social security fund for farmers," he said. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
